_meta.description: Curated verse corpus for the daily-news AI matcher. Each entry is tagged with topical applicability so a thinking-capable model (gemini-2.5-pro) can reason its way from a news story to the single verse that speaks most directly to its underlying spiritual / human question. Texts are public-domain or fair-use Christian-resource translations; YHWH is rendered as 'Yahweh' / '雅伟' / '雅偉' in line with the YsWords editorial preference applied at runtime.

verses.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verses.textZh-Hans: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。
verses.textZh-Hant: 使人和睦的人有福了，因為他們必稱為神的兒子。
verses.applies: Stories about active peace-making, ceasefires, or someone refusing to escalate.

verses.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verses.textZh-Hans: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。
verses.textZh-Hant: 他們要將刀打成犁頭，把槍打成鐮刀。
verses.applies: Arms control, military spending, weapons treaties — the prophetic vision of swords becoming tools.

verses.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你不可為惡所勝，反要以善勝惡。
verses.applies: Cycles of retaliation, terrorism, the temptation to mirror evil with evil.

verses.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verses.textZh-Hans: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。
verses.textZh-Hant: 若是能行，總要盡力與眾人和睦。
verses.applies: Diplomatic crises, broken negotiations, neighbor disputes.

verses.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verses.textZh-Hans: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。
verses.textZh-Hant: 他止息刀兵，直到地極；他折弓斷槍。
verses.applies: Global wars, persistent conflicts where peace seems impossible.

verses.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verses.textZh-Hans: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。
verses.textZh-Hant: 凡動刀的，必死在刀下。
verses.applies: Gun violence, escalating force, vigilante revenge.

verses.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verses.textZh-Hans: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。
verses.textZh-Hant: 雅偉向你所要的是什麼呢？只要你行公義，好憐憫，存謙卑的心，與你的神同行。
verses.applies: Anti-corruption, ethical leadership stories where justice and compassion meet.

verses.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verses.textZh-Hans: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。
verses.textZh-Hant: 惟願公平如大水滾滾，使公義如江河滔滔。
verses.applies: Civil rights movements, mass protests, calls for systemic justice.

verses.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你當為不能自辯的開口，為孤獨的伸冤。你當開口按公義判斷，為困苦和窮乏的辨屈。
verses.applies: Advocacy for those with no voice — children, disabled, trafficked, refugees.

verses.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verses.textZh-Hans: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。
verses.textZh-Hant: 學習行善，尋求公平，解救受欺壓的；給孤兒伸冤，為寡婦辨屈。
verses.applies: Stories of the oppressed, abuse victims, fatherless, broken families.

verses.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verses.textZh-Hans: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。
verses.textZh-Hant: 義人增多，民就喜樂；惡人掌權，民就嘆息。
verses.applies: Authoritarian regimes, corrupt governments, election crises.

verses.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verses.textZh-Hans: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。
verses.textZh-Hant: 公義使邦國高舉；罪惡是人民的羞辱。
verses.applies: National decline, scandals at the highest level, debates about national values.

verses.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verses.textZh-Hans: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。
verses.textZh-Hant: 因此律法放鬆，公理也不顯明；惡人圍困義人，所以公理顯然顛倒。
verses.applies: Stories of impunity, courts failing, systemic corruption — when justice itself seems broken.

verses.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verses.textZh-Hans: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。
verses.textZh-Hant: 無智謀，民就敗落；謀士多，人便安居。
verses.applies: Major policy decisions, leaders ignoring expert advice.

verses.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verses.textZh-Hans: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。
verses.textZh-Hant: 作惡為王所憎惡，因國位是靠公義堅立。
verses.applies: Leadership ethics, scandal-driven resignations.

verses.textEn: Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established.
verses.textZh-Hans: 在上有权柄的，人人当顺服他，因为没有权柄不是出于神的。
verses.textZh-Hant: 在上有權柄的，人人當順服他，因為沒有權柄不是出於神的。
verses.applies: Civic responsibility, debates about state authority.

verses.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verses.textZh-Hans: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。
verses.textZh-Hant: 沒有異象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便為有福。
verses.applies: Stories of social breakdown, generational drift, leadership voids.

verses.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verses.textZh-Hans: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。
verses.textZh-Hant: 暴虐的君王轄制貧民，好像吼叫的獅子、覓食的熊。
verses.applies: Tyrants, dictators, abuse of state power.

verses.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你們要施行公平和公義，拯救被搶奪的脫離欺壓人的手。
verses.applies: What governments owe their people; the moral mandate of public office.

verses.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verses.textZh-Hans: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。
verses.textZh-Hant: 我實在告訴你們，這些事你們既做在我這弟兄中一個最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。
verses.applies: Care for the marginalized — homeless, hungry, prisoners, sick, refugees.

verses.textEn: Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers? ... 'Go and do likewise.'
verses.textZh-Hans: 你想这三个人哪一个是落在强盗手中的邻舍呢？……「你去照样行吧。」
verses.textZh-Hant: 你想這三個人哪一個是落在強盜手中的鄰舍呢？……「你去照樣行吧。」
verses.applies: Stories that test who counts as 'neighbor' across social/ethnic lines.

verses.textEn: Suppose a brother or a sister is without clothes and daily food. If one of you says to them, 'Go in peace; keep warm and well fed,' but does nothing about their physical needs, what good is it?
verses.textZh-Hans: 若是弟兄或是姊妹，赤身露体，又缺了日用的饮食，你们中间有人对他们说：「平平安安地去吧，愿你们穿得暖、吃得饱」，却不给他们身体所需用的，这有什么益处呢？
verses.textZh-Hant: 若是弟兄或是姊妹，赤身露體，又缺了日用的飲食，你們中間有人對他們說：「平平安安地去吧，願你們穿得暖、吃得飽」，卻不給他們身體所需用的，這有什麼益處呢？
verses.applies: Performative compassion, social-media activism without action.

verses.textEn: Whoever is kind to the poor lends to Yahweh, and he will reward them for what they have done.
verses.textZh-Hans: 怜悯贫穷的，就是借给雅伟；他的善行，雅伟必偿还。
verses.textZh-Hant: 憐憫貧窮的，就是借給雅偉；他的善行，雅偉必償還。
verses.applies: Stories about charitable giving, aid programs.

verses.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verses.textZh-Hans: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？
verses.textZh-Hant: 不是要把你的餅分給飢餓的人，將飄流的窮人接到你家中，見赤身的給他衣服遮體？
verses.applies: Hunger, homelessness, displacement crises.

verses.textEn: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.
verses.textZh-Hans: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。
verses.textZh-Hant: 所以你們要憐愛寄居的，因為你們在埃及地也作過寄居的。
verses.applies: Immigration debates, refugee crises, deportation stories.

verses.textEn: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor.
verses.textZh-Hans: 主的灵在我身上，因为他用膏膏我，叫我传福音给贫穷的人。
verses.textZh-Hant: 主的靈在我身上，因為他用膏膏我，叫我傳福音給貧窮的人。
verses.applies: Anti-poverty work, prison ministry, addiction recovery.

verses.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你所做的，要交託雅偉，你所謀的，就必成立。
verses.applies: Major business ventures, entrepreneurial stories, project launches.

verses.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for human masters.
verses.textZh-Hans: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。
verses.textZh-Hant: 無論做什麼，都要從心裡做，像是給主做的，不是給人做的。
verses.applies: Labor stories, craftsmanship, dignity of work.

verses.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verses.textZh-Hans: 贪财是万恶之根。
verses.textZh-Hant: 貪財是萬惡之根。
verses.applies: Financial fraud, corporate greed, Ponzi schemes.

verses.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verses.textZh-Hans: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。
verses.textZh-Hant: 富戶管轄窮人；欠債的是債主的僕人。
verses.applies: Debt crises, payday loans, sovereign debt, household debt.

verses.textEn: No one can serve two masters... You cannot serve both God and Mammon.
verses.textZh-Hans: 一个人不能事奉两个主……你们不能又事奉神，又事奉玛门。
verses.textZh-Hant: 一個人不能事奉兩個主……你們不能又事奉神，又事奉瑪門。
verses.applies: Stories where wealth-pursuit collides with deeper values.

verses.textEn: Woe to him who builds his palace by unrighteousness, who makes his own people work for nothing.
verses.textZh-Hans: 那行不义盖房、行不公造楼、白白使用人的手工不给工价的有祸了！
verses.textZh-Hant: 那行不義蓋房、行不公造樓、白白使用人的手工不給工價的有禍了！
verses.applies: Wage exploitation, sweatshops, unpaid workers.

verses.textEn: A good person leaves an inheritance for their children's children, but a sinner's wealth is stored up for the righteous.
verses.textZh-Hans: 善人给子孙遗留产业；罪人为义人积存资财。
verses.textZh-Hant: 善人給子孫遺留產業；罪人為義人積存資財。
verses.applies: Inheritance disputes, generational wealth, retirement crises.

verses.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你要記念雅偉你的神，因為得貨財的力量是他給你的。
verses.applies: Economic boom, prosperity reports — what we forget when things go well.

verses.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verses.textZh-Hans: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。
verses.textZh-Hant: 凡是真實的、可敬的、公義的、清潔的、可愛的、有美名的，這些事你們都要思念。
verses.applies: Information overload, doomscrolling, media diet questions.

verses.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verses.textZh-Hans: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。
verses.textZh-Hant: 先訴情由的，似乎有理；但鄰舍來到，就察出實情。
verses.applies: Viral allegations, rushed verdicts in the court of social media.

verses.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verses.textZh-Hans: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。
verses.textZh-Hant: 所以你們要棄絕謊言，各人與鄰舍說實話。
verses.applies: Disinformation, deepfakes, propaganda.

verses.textEn: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
verses.textZh-Hans: 口吐真言，永远坚立；舌说谎话，只存片时。
verses.textZh-Hant: 口吐真言，永遠堅立；舌說謊話，只存片時。
verses.applies: Lies eventually exposed, fact-check victories.

verses.textEn: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你们必晓得真理，真理必叫你们得以自由。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你們必曉得真理，真理必叫你們得以自由。
verses.applies: Transparency campaigns, whistleblowers, investigative journalism.

verses.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verses.textZh-Hans: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。
verses.textZh-Hant: 愚蒙人是話都信；通達人步步謹慎。
verses.applies: Conspiracy theories, viral misinformation, gullible audiences.

verses.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verses.textZh-Hans: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。
verses.textZh-Hant: 就是在患難中也是歡歡喜喜的；因為知道患難生忍耐，忍耐生老練，老練生盼望。
verses.applies: Recovery from disaster, communities rebuilding.

verses.textEn: For I know the plans I have for you, declares Yahweh, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
verses.textZh-Hans: 我知道我向你们所怀的意念，是赐平安的意念，不是降灾祸的意念，要叫你们末后有指望。这是雅伟说的。
verses.textZh-Hant: 我知道我向你們所懷的意念，是賜平安的意念，不是降災禍的意念，要叫你們末後有指望。這是雅偉說的。
verses.applies: National despair, exile narratives, generational pessimism.

verses.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verses.textZh-Hans: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。
verses.textZh-Hant: 但那等候雅偉的，必從新得力。他們必如鷹展翅上騰。
verses.applies: Burnout, exhaustion, finding second wind.

verses.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verses.textZh-Hans: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。
verses.textZh-Hant: 雖然無花果樹不發旺，葡萄樹不結果……然而，我要因雅偉歡欣。
verses.applies: Famine, crop failure, severe economic hardship.

verses.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verses.textZh-Hans: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。
verses.textZh-Hant: 神要擦去他們一切的眼淚；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭號、疼痛。
verses.applies: Tragedies, mass casualty events, profound grief.

verses.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verses.textZh-Hans: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。
verses.textZh-Hant: 一宿雖然有哭泣，早晨便必歡呼。
verses.applies: Sudden reversals — grief turning to relief.

verses.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verses.textZh-Hans: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。
verses.textZh-Hant: 我們不至消滅，是出於雅偉諸般的慈愛；是因他的憐憫不至斷絕。每早晨這都是新的。
verses.applies: Sustained crises — wars, occupations, prolonged disasters.

verses.textEn: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.textZh-Hans: 为义受逼迫的人有福了，因为天国是他们的。
verses.textZh-Hant: 為義受逼迫的人有福了，因為天國是他們的。
verses.applies: Religious persecution, Christians under pressure.

verses.textEn: In fact, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.
verses.textZh-Hans: 凡立志在基督耶稣里敬虔度日的，也都要受逼迫。
verses.textZh-Hant: 凡立志在基督耶穌裡敬虔度日的，也都要受逼迫。
verses.applies: Faith-based discrimination, social hostility to believers.

verses.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verses.textZh-Hans: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。
verses.textZh-Hant: 順從神，不順從人，是應當的。
verses.applies: Conscientious objection, civil disobedience for moral reasons.

verses.textEn: I consider that our present sufferings are not worth comparing with the glory that will be revealed in us.
verses.textZh-Hans: 我想，现在的苦楚若比起将来要显于我们的荣耀，就不足介意了。
verses.textZh-Hant: 我想，現在的苦楚若比起將來要顯於我們的榮耀，就不足介意了。
verses.applies: Chronic suffering, long-running injustice.

verses.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verses.textZh-Hans: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。
verses.textZh-Hant: 因此，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。
verses.applies: Marriage stories, wedding-related news.

verses.textEn: 'The man who hates and divorces his wife,' says Yahweh, 'does violence to the one he should protect.'
verses.textZh-Hans: 雅伟说：「休妻的事，是我所恨恶的。」
verses.textZh-Hant: 雅偉說：「休妻的事，是我所恨惡的。」
verses.applies: High-profile divorces, marriage statistics, family breakdown.

verses.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verses.textZh-Hans: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。
verses.textZh-Hant: 兒女是雅偉所賜的產業。
verses.applies: Birth rate stories, IVF, fertility, parenting.

verses.textEn: Fathers, do not exasperate your children; instead, bring them up in the training and instruction of the Lord.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你们作父亲的，不要惹儿女的气，只要照着主的教训和警戒养育他们。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你們作父親的，不要惹兒女的氣，只要照著主的教訓和警戒養育他們。
verses.applies: Parenting, education debates, fatherhood.

verses.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verses.textZh-Hans: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。
verses.textZh-Hant: 教養孩童，使他走當行的道，就是到老他也不偏離。
verses.applies: Education policy, curriculum debates, generational character.

verses.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verses.textZh-Hans: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。
verses.textZh-Hant: 生死在舌頭的權下；喜愛它的，必吃它所結的果子。
verses.applies: Hate speech, online vitriol, cancel culture.

verses.textEn: The tongue is a small part of the body, but it makes great boasts. Consider what a great forest is set on fire by a small spark.
verses.textZh-Hans: 舌头在百体里也是最小的，却能说大话。看哪，最小的火能点着最大的树林。
verses.textZh-Hant: 舌頭在百體裡也是最小的，卻能說大話。看哪，最小的火能點著最大的樹林。
verses.applies: Viral tweets, off-the-cuff comments igniting scandals.

verses.textEn: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
verses.textZh-Hans: 回答柔和，使怒消退；言语暴戾，触动怒气。
verses.textZh-Hant: 回答柔和，使怒消退；言語暴戾，觸動怒氣。
verses.applies: Public apologies, de-escalation, mediation.

verses.textEn: Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你们的言语要常常带着和气，好像用盐调和。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你們的言語要常常帶著和氣，好像用鹽調和。
verses.applies: Christian leaders speaking publicly, testimony in hostile spaces.

verses.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verses.textZh-Hans: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。
verses.textZh-Hant: 神就照著自己的形象造人，乃是照著他的形象造男造女。
verses.applies: Human dignity questions, AI vs human, personhood debates.

verses.textEn: What is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
verses.textZh-Hans: 人算什么，你竟顾念他？
verses.textZh-Hant: 人算什麼，你竟顧念他？
verses.applies: Big-picture stories about human worth, space exploration, cosmic context.

verses.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verses.textZh-Hans: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。
verses.textZh-Hant: 地和其中所充滿的，世界和住在其間的，都屬雅偉。
verses.applies: Climate, environment, ecology, conservation.

verses.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verses.textZh-Hans: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。
verses.textZh-Hant: 雅偉神將那人安置在伊甸園，使他修理看守。
verses.applies: Climate change, pollution, biodiversity loss.

verses.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verses.textZh-Hans: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。
verses.textZh-Hant: 我們知道，一切受造之物一同嘆息、勞苦，直到如今。
verses.applies: Natural disasters, ecosystem collapse, environmental tragedies.

verses.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verses.textZh-Hans: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。
verses.textZh-Hant: 按著定命，人人都有一死，死後且有審判。
verses.applies: Notable deaths, end-of-life stories, aging populations.

verses.textEn: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verses.textZh-Hans: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。
verses.textZh-Hant: 求你指教我們怎樣數算自己的日子，好叫我們得著智慧的心。
verses.applies: Aging societies, life-expectancy data, time-pressure stories.

verses.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verses.textZh-Hans: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。
verses.textZh-Hant: 凡事都有定期，天下萬務都有定時。
verses.applies: Major transitions, retirements, end-of-an-era moments.

verses.textEn: I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die.
verses.textZh-Hans: 复活在我，生命也在我。信我的人虽然死了，也必复活。
verses.textZh-Hant: 復活在我，生命也在我。信我的人雖然死了，也必復活。
verses.applies: Funerals of believers, hope beyond death.

verses.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verses.textZh-Hans: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。
verses.textZh-Hant: 他醫好傷心的人，裹好他們的傷處。
verses.applies: Mental health crises, trauma recovery.

verses.textEn: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
verses.textZh-Hans: 凡劳苦担重担的人，可以到我这里来，我就使你们得安息。
verses.textZh-Hant: 凡勞苦擔重擔的人，可以到我這裡來，我就使你們得安息。
verses.applies: Burnout, overwork, stress epidemics.

verses.textEn: Yahweh is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verses.textZh-Hans: 雅伟靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。
verses.textZh-Hant: 雅偉靠近傷心的人，拯救靈性痛悔的人。
verses.applies: Suicide, deep depression, mental anguish stories.

verses.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你們中間有病了的呢，他就該請教會的長老來；他們可以奉主的名用油抹他，為他禱告。
verses.applies: Illness, disease outbreaks, healthcare stories.

verses.textEn: For if you forgive other people when they sin against you, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你们饶恕人的过犯，你们的天父也必饶恕你们的过犯。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你們饒恕人的過犯，你們的天父也必饒恕你們的過犯。
verses.applies: Truth commissions, public apologies, reconciliation efforts.

verses.textEn: Bear with each other and forgive one another if any of you has a grievance against someone.
verses.textZh-Hans: 倘若这人与那人有嫌隙，总要彼此包容，彼此饶恕。
verses.textZh-Hant: 倘若這人與那人有嫌隙，總要彼此包容，彼此饒恕。
verses.applies: Workplace conflicts, family disputes, lingering grievances.

verses.textEn: All this is from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation.
verses.textZh-Hans: 这一切都是出于神；他借着基督使我们与他和好，又将劝人与他和好的职分赐给我们。
verses.textZh-Hant: 這一切都是出於神；他藉著基督使我們與他和好，又將勸人與他和好的職分賜給我們。
verses.applies: Peace processes, mediation, NGO reconciliation work.

verses.textEn: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat; if he is thirsty, give him water to drink.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你的仇敌若饿了，就给他饭吃；若渴了，就给他水喝。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你的仇敵若餓了，就給他飯吃；若渴了，就給他水喝。
verses.applies: Humanitarian aid to opponents, prisoner-of-war stories.

verses.textEn: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.textZh-Hans: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。
verses.textZh-Hant: 驕傲在敗壞以先；狂心在跌倒之前。
verses.applies: Downfalls — celebrity, corporate, political.

verses.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verses.textZh-Hans: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。
verses.textZh-Hant: 惟有神斷定；他使這人降卑，使那人升高。
verses.applies: Surprise promotions, dramatic falls, election upsets.

verses.textEn: God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble.
verses.textZh-Hans: 神阻挡骄傲的人，赐恩给谦卑的人。
verses.textZh-Hant: 神阻擋驕傲的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。
verses.applies: Stories of servant leadership vs ego-driven leaders.

verses.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verses.textZh-Hans: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。
verses.textZh-Hant: 凡事不可結黨，不可貪圖虛浮的榮耀；只要存心謙卑，各人看別人比自己強。
verses.applies: Partisan politics, celebrity culture, ego clashes.

verses.textEn: Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.
verses.textZh-Hans: 小子们哪，你们要自守，远避偶像。
verses.textZh-Hant: 小子們哪，你們要自守，遠避偶像。
verses.applies: Celebrity worship, tech addiction, consumerism.

verses.textEn: You shall have no other gods before me.
verses.textZh-Hans: 除了我以外，你不可有别的神。
verses.textZh-Hant: 除了我以外，你不可有別的神。
verses.applies: Ideological cults, extremist movements, nationalism elevated to religion.

verses.textEn: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moths and vermin destroy.
verses.textZh-Hans: 不要为自己积攒财宝在地上；地上有虫子咬，能锈坏。
verses.textZh-Hant: 不要為自己積攢財寶在地上；地上有蟲子咬，能銹壞。
verses.applies: Wealth-loss stories, crypto crashes, market crashes.

verses.textEn: There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.textZh-Hans: 并不分犹太人、希利尼人，自主的、为奴的，或男或女，因为你们在基督耶稣里都成为一了。
verses.textZh-Hant: 並不分猶太人、希利尼人，自主的、為奴的，或男或女，因為你們在基督耶穌裡都成為一了。
verses.applies: Racial unity, class divisions, identity-based conflict.

verses.textEn: From one man he made all the nations, that they should inhabit the whole earth.
verses.textZh-Hans: 他从一本造出万族的人，住在全地上。
verses.textZh-Hant: 他從一本造出萬族的人，住在全地上。
verses.applies: Ethnic nationalism, tribalism, white-supremacist movements.

verses.textEn: A great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people and language, standing before the throne.
verses.textZh-Hans: 许多的人，没有人能数过来，是从各国、各族、各民、各方来的，站在宝座……前。
verses.textZh-Hant: 許多的人，沒有人能數過來，是從各國、各族、各民、各方來的，站在寶座……前。
verses.applies: Global worship, multicultural celebrations, mission stories.

verses.textEn: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的神，主就必赐给他。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你們中間若有缺少智慧的，應當求那厚賜與眾人、也不斥責人的神，主就必賜給他。
verses.applies: Major decisions, leaders facing impossible choices.

verses.textEn: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你要专心仰赖雅伟，不可倚靠自己的聪明。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你要專心仰賴雅偉，不可倚靠自己的聰明。
verses.applies: Big-tech futurism, AI confidence, human limits.

verses.textEn: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
verses.textZh-Hans: 敬畏雅伟是智慧的开端；认识至圣者便是聪明。
verses.textZh-Hant: 敬畏雅偉是智慧的開端；認識至聖者便是聰明。
verses.applies: Educated foolishness — credentials without wisdom.

verses.textEn: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
verses.textZh-Hans: 应当一无挂虑，只要凡事藉着祷告、祈求和感谢，将你们所要的告诉神。
verses.textZh-Hant: 應當一無掛慮，只要凡事藉著禱告、祈求和感謝，將你們所要的告訴神。
verses.applies: Anxiety stories, panic responses, mental-health awareness.

verses.textEn: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你不要害怕，因為我與你同在；不要驚惶，因為我是你的神。
verses.applies: Fearful headlines — existential threats, looming dangers.

verses.textEn: For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love and self-discipline.
verses.textZh-Hans: 神赐给我们，不是胆怯的心，乃是刚强、仁爱、谨守的心。
verses.textZh-Hant: 神賜給我們，不是膽怯的心，乃是剛強、仁愛、謹守的心。
verses.applies: Mass-panic responses, fear-driven politics, calls for courage.

verses.textEn: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me.
verses.textZh-Hans: 我虽然行过死荫的幽谷，也不怕遭害，因为你与我同在。
verses.textZh-Hant: 我雖然行過死蔭的幽谷，也不怕遭害，因為你與我同在。
verses.applies: Life-threatening situations, war zones, terminal diagnoses.

verses.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verses.textZh-Hans: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。
verses.textZh-Hant: 神是我們的避難所，是我們的力量，是我們在患難中隨時的幫助。
verses.applies: Natural disasters, emergencies, crisis points.

verses.textEn: Love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你要尽心、尽性、尽力爱雅伟你的神。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你要盡心、盡性、盡力愛雅偉你的神。
verses.applies: Spiritual drift, lukewarm faith, recovery of devotion.

verses.textEn: Love your neighbor as yourself.
verses.textZh-Hans: 要爱人如己。
verses.textZh-Hant: 要愛人如己。
verses.applies: Community-building stories, acts of kindness, social-fabric repair.

verses.textEn: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.
verses.textZh-Hans: 你们若有彼此相爱的心，众人因此就认出你们是我的门徒了。
verses.textZh-Hant: 你們若有彼此相愛的心，眾人因此就認出你們是我的門徒了。
verses.applies: Christian witness, church-public-image stories.

verses.textEn: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.
verses.textZh-Hans: 如今常存的有信，有望，有爱这三样，其中最大的是爱。
verses.textZh-Hant: 如今常存的有信，有望，有愛這三樣，其中最大的是愛。
verses.applies: Stories that transcend the news cycle and call us back to enduring values.
